items.title: 3 Legacy Dividend Stocks That Never Go Out of Style
items.summary: Coke, Tide and Kleenex have sat in American homes for generations, and the companies behind them keep raising their payouts. But one of these three Dividend Kings carries a debt load that could test its streak.

items.title: Kimberly-Clark’s Dividend Is Up 392% Since 1999. Can Its $49 Billion Deal Put That at Risk?
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark has raised its payout for 54 straight years, yet last year's cash flow barely covered the check. With the Kenvue deal now closed and debt climbing, a few telltale signs will show whether the streak holds.

items.title: Kenvue (KVUE) Stock Still Looks Cheap Despite Its 27% Run
items.summary: Kenvue has delivered a 26.9% gain over the past year, and after a string of mixed but steady business updates, the key issue now is how much of that share price move is backed by the cash the company can generate over time. With the stock last closing at US$19.31 and a takeover by Kimberly-Clark progressing, investors are increasingly asking whether the current valuation still lines up with the underlying cash flows of the business. items.title: 4 Dividend Stocks Yielding Up to 4.8% That Just Raised Their Payouts
items.summary: Bond coupons never grow, but these four payers just handed shareholders a raise. One has a cash-rich balance sheet, one faces a $49 billion gamble, one is heading for a breakup, and one has a blemish on its record.

items.title: KMB Q3 Earnings Call Focuses on Kenvue Integration and Growth
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark's Q3 earnings rose 17.2% despite softer sales, as Kenvue integration, $1.9B in synergies and inflation pressures shape its growth strategy.

items.summary: Kimberly-Clark Corp (KMB) wraps its landmark Kenvue acquisition, targets ~$1.9 billion in cost synergies, and works to rebuild trust in China while navigating soft North America personal care.

items.title: What Kimberly-Clark (KMB) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark (NASDAQ:KMB) has completed its acquisition of Kenvue and is beginning a multiyear integration, with executives saying on the company’s third-quarter earnings call that they remain on track to deliver about $1.9 billion in cost synergies. items.summary: KimberlyClark shares have stagnated for several years as topline growth struggles to advance.
